headword: {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}

definitions.explanation: The government function of regulating the entry of foreign nationals into a country — checking passports and visas, issuing residence permits, and enforcing immigration law. Also used to refer to the system or agency responsible for these tasks. Frequently shortened to {入管|にゅうかん}.

examples.japanese: {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧。
⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I went through immigration inspection at the airport.

examples.japanese: {法務省|ほうむしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The Ministry of Justice is moving forward with a review of the immigration control system.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{入国|にゅうこく}→入国：15859_nyuukoku⟧ ('entering a country') and ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ ('management; control; administration'). Refers both to the regulatory function itself and, by extension, to the offices and officials who carry it out.

USAGE:
- A standard term in news reports, legal documents, and travel contexts.
- Often abbreviated to {入管|にゅうかん} in casual reference, news headlines, and institution names: {入管|にゅうかん}⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ ('Immigration Control Act'), {入管|にゅうかん}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧ ('immigration facility').
- In Japan, the relevant agency is the ⟦{出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}→出入国：24874_shutsunyuukoku⟧⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧{管理庁|かんりちょう} (Immigration Services Agency), usually shortened to {入管庁|にゅうかんちょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{局|きょく}: Immigration Bureau (the former name of the agency)
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{法|ほう}: Immigration Control Act
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{審査|しんさ}→審査：08375_shinsa⟧: immigration inspection
- ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧{入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}: strict immigration control
- {入国|にゅうこく}{管理|かんり}{官|かん}: immigration officer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入管|にゅうかん}: the common abbreviation — widely used in news headlines and speech.
- ⟦{出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}→出入国：24874_shutsunyuukoku⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: immigration and emigration control — the broader official term covering both entry and exit.
- ⟦{税関|ぜいかん}→税関：04380_zeikan⟧: customs — a separate function dealing with goods rather than people.
- ⟦ビザ→ビザ：08283_biza⟧: visa — the document whose issuance and checking is central to immigration control.
